entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: Gemini's own archive refused this project on 2026-09-17 (403 to its JSON search and its search form, with and without a browser user agent), and it offers a REST interface rather than TAP. Its public data are also at CADC, which answered anonymously, so Gemini data are reachable through CADC's TAP service.
entries.revisitWhen: A body in this repository needs Gemini data; then query CADC rather than the Gemini archive.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Science data usually carry a 12-month proprietary period, reduced from 18 months in 2016A, with metadata and most calibrations public at once; non-proprietary data need no login to download. No reuse licence is published. The NSF NOIRLab acknowledgement wording could not be read: gemini.edu and noirlab.edu refuse this project's requests.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: DRAGONS is Gemini's reduction platform, distributed as a conda package and on GitHub under the BSD 3-clause licence.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.

entries.subject: What this archive holds for catalogued bodies
entries.finding: The same screen matched 118 bodies across CADC's Gemini and CFHT collections, 59,021 rows, largest instruments NIRI (37543), GNIRS (6171), ESPaDOnS (5604). The counts are archive-wide, not per telescope.
entries.revisitWhen: A Gemini or CFHT candidate from the screen is taken up.
